scenario_scope.units: CNY billion; shares billion; DPS CNY
scenario_scope.parent_start: H1 latest separate-company balances; Q3 parent bridge unavailable, no additional H2 cash assumed
scenario_scope.core_low_changes: profit -5% reaches both entities; parent net cash falls by same amount as parent profit; full external claim at year-1 start; parent support funding boundary; first-year upstream .5225 withheld; full new support plus existing HK investment impaired for parent legal-capacity stress; dividend capped annually
scenario_scope.core_high_changes: profit +5% reaches both entities; r .095, g .025; no legal settlement
scenario_scope.frozen: share count, reinvestment, opening group assets, parent 4bn and group 5.5bn operating buffers, target dividend schedule, 1.5% group cash yield; no new debt or asset sale
scenario_scope.baseline: profit scale 1, no claim, r .10/g .02; interface terminal range changes only r/g
scenario_scope.upstream: aggregate .55bn budget; no identified HK component, first-year total blockade is an upper bound, not reported HK dividend
scenario_scope.impairment: funding creates parent investment; full impairment is legal-profit capacity boundary, not a second consolidated cost or legal liability finding

tests.cash_conservation: passed for group and parent separately

capital_policy.basis: FY2025 mother appropriation .49673309965 = 10% profit despite saturation. Core continues discretionary policy through Y10 only; Y5/Y20 end and permanent boundary tested. Future stop is governance budget, not fact.
capital_policy.upstream_basis: H1 cost-method dividend income .55277771519; FY2025 .02207624149, FY2024 .13096038359. Conditional budget, not recurrent historical fact.
capital_policy.foreign_law: No PRC reserve computation applied to Hong Kong or aggregated sources.
capital_policy.future_capital: No issuance/subscription/new paid cash assumed. Support is parent investment funding, not proof of registered-capital increase.

terminal_method: Y6 onward actual holder distributions with separate mother/source economic budget; no group cash or operating-terminal addback.
